morphology.look_here_first: Look closely at foliage and calyx: low dense clumps with narrow cauline leaves and conspicuous tack-shaped glandular hairs; the calyx is strongly ribbed with tiny awned tips.
diagnostic_traits: perennial low dense clump with many stems
only cauline leaves rather than a basal-leaf set
linear leaves with paired bases forming a short sheath across the node
3-flowered cymes repeated at closely spaced nodes
strongly 10-ridged calyx with short awned lobe tips
pale blue-violet flower with broad white/violet-marked lower lip

confusers.separator: Engelmann sage lacks the basal-leaf pattern of S. texana and has obvious tack-shaped glands, 3-flowered cymes, and a paler strongly marked lower lip.
Engelmann sage is much shorter and bushier, with a compact terminal series of verticils rather than Azure sage's tall open flowering axis.

diagnostic_roles: narrow cauline leaves / fused node bases
